svg.text: SAdiy SBC adapter: BeagleBone Black cape OR Raspberry Pi ribbon cable to the module boards
Use ONE SBC at a time. Every SBC signal has a 220 ohm series resistor on each side, so a mistake with both attached limits the contention current.
BeagleBone Black headers (male pins on the BOTTOM side of the PCB)
Raspberry Pi 40-pin (IDC box header, ribbon cable)
Signal rows: BBB side - 220 ohm - common net - 220 ohm - RPi side
PE4302 attenuator (parallel control, header GND V1..V6)
Pull-ups R27..R32: with the module's 10k pull-downs the boot default is about 2.7 V = 31.5 dB.
Remove them if you want 0 dB when the SBC is off.
J5: red lead = VDD (3.3 V), black = GND. Measure the pads before connecting.
ADF4351 board (SPI + lock detect, 5 V on its DC jack)
J6 pin 2 (board 3V3) stays open: it is the AMS1117 output.
Pin order assumed from hw/netlist.md; check against the board silkscreen.
CE: jumper 1-2 = tied high (default), 2-3 = SBC pin
JP5 fitted = PDR high (RF on). Remove if the board already pulls it up.
J7: check the polarity marking at the DC jack before connecting.
J8: find which header pin is OUT with a DMM first, then match pin 1.
BBB path (AIN0, 1.8 V max): ratio 0.75, RC and clamp. Fit JP6 only for the BBB.
RPi / ADS1115 path (A0): 1k, 100n, clamp to 3V3 and ground.
DNP I2C pull-ups: the Pi has 1.8k on SDA1/SCL1,
the BBB has them on I2C2.
Power: external 5 V and/or SBC, 3.3 V from the SBC
JP1 fitted: BBB VDD_5V (P9.5/6) joins the rail
JP2 fitted: RPi 5V (pins 2/4) joins the rail
A) external 5V on J11 powers the SBC: fit that SBC's jumper,
and do NOT plug the SBC's own supply
B) SBC powers the modules: fit its jumper, leave J11 empty
(a BBB on USB only has no VDD_5V)
JP3 fitted for the BBB, JP4 for the RPi, never both
Ferrite beads isolate the module supplies from the SBC rails.
R38 joins AGND (detector return, BBB GNDA_ADC) to GND at one point.
PLACEMENT (the SBC and the modules are on opposite sides of the board)
J1, J2: BBB headers, 2x23 male pins, bodies on the BOTTOM side, long pins down into the BBB sockets. Pin 1 of P8/P9 as on the BBB.
J3: 2x20 shrouded IDC header, TOP side, at the board edge, for a straight 1:1 ribbon to the Pi (pin n to pin n).
J4..J12, jumpers, test points, ferrites, caps: TOP side. Keep ~25 mm clear above the BBB Ethernet/USB/HDMI area.
Put the analog front end (R33, R34, C1, D1, D2, R38) next to J8 and P9.34/P9.39. One star point for GND/AGND (R38).
SYN_CLK/SYN_DATA/SYN_LE: SPI0 mode 0, MSB first, 32-bit words. SYN_LD is an input to the SBC. SYN_CE and SYN_PDR are static.
ATT_V1..V6 = 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 dB (assumed, high = stage in). Verify with tools/bringup.py pe4302-walk.
BBB I2C2 (P9.19/20) and RPi I2C1 (pins 3/5) share I2C_SCL/I2C_SDA for the ADS1115.
OPEN POINTS: PE4302 and ADF4351 header pin order, detector OUT pin, DC jack polarity, ferrite and fuse values: confirm with a DMM.
Unused BBB/RPi pins carry no connection (X). Names of unused BBB pins come from the BBB system reference, not from the repo.
